name: Payment Service
description: Microservice handling payment charges with upstream user credit lookup
change_description: Change the default timeout on fetch_user from 5s to 2s to speed up the service
diff:
--- a/payment_service/client.py
+++ b/payment_service/client.py
@@ -8,7 +8,7 @@ import time
 
 # THIS IS THE VALUE UNDER CHANGE
 # Scenario: we want to reduce this from 5.0 to 2.0 to "speed up" the service.
-DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 5.0  # seconds
+DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 2.0  # seconds
 
 
 def fetch_user(user_id: str, timeout: float = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT) -> dict:
key_insight: The billing retry loop was designed assuming a ~5s per-call timeout. Reducing it to 2s makes the total retry window too tight for the SLA monitoring thresholds, without billing.py ever importing DEFAULT_TIMEOUT directly.
